title: Common providers: Italy
coverage: Complete for the national fixed-line carriers, the mobile network operators and the two wholesale access networks; regional fibre operators, fixed-wireless operators and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Regional fibre and fixed-wireless operators (several hundred are on the regulator's register)
An AS number for iliad (none confirmed: the number it is known by is registered to another company of the group)
A website for Open Fiber (it answered an automated request only with a refusal or a bot check on the read date)

sources.name: AGCOM: Registro degli Operatori di Comunicazione (public list)
sources.terms: The public list of the register refused an automated read on the read date and no reuse terms were found on the regulator's front page: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The front page answered on the read date; the register was not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Italy
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 2 of 17 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Italy
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 0 of 17 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 16 of 17 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked. An address that answered only with a refusal, a bot check or a page-not-found page counts as one that did not answer.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 24 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 2 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: Fastweb: Fastweb and Vodafone Italia merge
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: the merger took effect on 1 January 2026 and the company is Fastweb S.p.A.

sources.name: Retelit: completion of the purchase of BT Italia's operations
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: completed on 1 October 2025 through the new company Retelit-X.

sources.name: Teleborsa: lease of Tiscali Italia's consumer business
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: leased to Smeraldo (Canarbino group) from 1 June 2026, with the Tiscali and Linkem names licensed to it.

providers.name: TIM
providers.notes: The incumbent; fixed and mobile. Its fixed access network is run by FiberCop.

providers.name: Fastweb
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile; owned by Swisscom. Merged with Vodafone Italia on 1 January 2026.

providers.name: Vodafone Italia
providers.notes: A name of Fastweb S.p.A. since the merger of 1 January 2026; AS30722 is registered to Fastweb.

providers.name: iliad
providers.notes: Mobile, and fibre over the wholesale networks.

providers.name: FiberCop
providers.notes: Wholesale fixed access network, formerly TIM's; seldom the name on the bill.

providers.name: Open Fiber
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre access network; retail through other providers.

providers.name: Tiscali
providers.notes: Run by Smeraldo (Canarbino group) under a lease since 1 June 2026; AS8612 is registered to Smeraldo.

providers.name: Sky Italia
providers.notes: Broadband under the name Sky Wifi, over the wholesale networks.

providers.name: Retelit
providers.notes: Business fibre and data centres. Took over BT Italia's operations on 1 October 2025; AS8968 was BT Italia's number.

providers.name: GARR
providers.notes: The national research and education network.
